full_name: Eden Medina | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 History Rita E. Hauser Fellow Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bio: Eden Medina is an associate professor in the Program for Science, Technology, and Society at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Her research uses the history of science and technology as a way to understand processes of political change, especially in Latin America. She is the author of Cybernetic Revolutionaries: Technology and Politics in Allende’s Chile (MIT Press, 2011) and coeditor of Beyond Imported Magic: Essays on Science, Technology, and Society in Latin America (MIT Press, 2014).
